LanguageData.RadiologyBasic.label: radiology
LanguageData.RadiologyBasic.description: Build radiology chamber and use irradiators to bombard your colonists with harmful radiation.
LanguageData.RadiologyBlocking.label: radiation blocking
LanguageData.RadiologyBlocking.description: Build a blocker that makes it possible to stop radiation passing through it from reaching certain body parts.
LanguageData.RadiologyBlockingAdvanced.label: advanced blocking
LanguageData.RadiologyBlockingAdvanced.description: Build an advanced variation of blocker that has a better chance of deflecting radiation and lets you select more body parts to protect.
LanguageData.RadiologyBlockingIntermediate.label: intermediate blocking
LanguageData.RadiologyBlockingIntermediate.descriptio: Build an intermediate variation of blocker that has a better chance of deflecting radiation and lets you select more body parts to protect.
LanguageData.RadiologyFiltering.label: radiation filtering
LanguageData.RadiologyFiltering.description: Build a filter that makes it possible to alter radiation passing through it.
LanguageData.RadiologyFilteringAdvanced.label: advanced filtering
LanguageData.RadiologyFilteringAdvanced.description: Unlocks additional operation modes for a filter.
LanguageData.RadiologyFilteringIntermediate.label: intermediate filtering
LanguageData.RadiologyFilteringIntermediate.descripti: Unlocks additional operation modes for a filter.
LanguageData.RadiologyFilteringTradeoff.label: tradeoff filtering
LanguageData.RadiologyFilteringTradeoff.description: Unlocks additional operation modes for a filter.
LanguageData.RadiologyIntermediate.label: intermediate radiology
LanguageData.RadiologyIntermediate.description: Build an improved version of irradiator.
LanguageData.RadiologyMonitoring.label: radiation monitor
LanguageData.RadiologyMonitoring.description: Build a monitor that allows to see detailed information about what kind of radiation is being applied at a chamber.
